UI_ItemRarity_Presentation_Description: Client-side visual preferences. These settings never change loot, rarity calculations, or published tiers.
UI_ItemRarity_Option_ColorInventoryNames: Color item names using their published rarity tier.
UI_ItemRarity_Option_TooltipBorder_Toolt: Draw the rarity-colored border around item tooltips.
UI_ItemRarity_Option_TooltipLabel_Toolti: Show the rarity line below the vanilla item tooltip.
UI_ItemRarity_Option_HotbarRarity_Toolti: Draw rarity borders and markers on occupied hotbar slots.
UI_ItemRarity_Option_CommonVanillaColor_: Leave COMMON item names in the game's original inventory color.
